source_detail: Berg, Kaiser et al., "Language Models Act on Hidden Valence", arXiv 2609.35591v1, submitted 2026-09-28 (primary); read via summarizing fetch tool, 2026-11-05; values unverified against the PDF. Promo: video description (Reciprocal Research / AM I?), secondary
design: valence directions from first-person passages (4 positive, 4 negative states; 96 neutral) written by Claude Sonnet 4.6; middle layer; top-10 neutral PCs removed; scaled to residual norm. Hidden-state steering over fixed text in 7 models; self-steering arm on OLMo-2-32B only (tools 'adjustment' and 'reset' named, effects not described, no cost, neutral framing). Models: OLMo-2-32B (Base / SFT / DPO / Instruct), Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Mistral-Small-24B, Gemma-3-27B, Llama-3.1-8B. Controls: norm-matched random directions; non-valence concept directions (|cos| <= 0.07); sign reversal; text held constant in the hidden-state channel; recall accuracy checked
